newsitem.title: GERMANY: Germany's eff-eff sees profits up.
newsitem.headline: Germany's eff-eff sees profits up.

text.p: German security systems manufacturer eff-eff Fritz Fuss GmbH, which made its debut on the Frankfurt bourse last year, said on Tuesday that it expected higher sales and profits this year and next.

Sales for 1996 should rise two percent to 191 million marks, on the basis of current developments and earnings should increase by three to five percent because of improved cost structures, the firm said in a mandatory statement.
Sales for the 1997 business year should reach 200 million marks and earnings are expected to rise at an above-average rate, eff-eff forecast.
